draft.title: Motux and Bilcas
draft.summary: Xerez’s Motux rest and Sancho’s Bilcas entry, setting and route.

claims.text: Xerez reports four days at Motux and an extensive fertile valley.
Sancho records next-day early entry at Bilcas, a high mountain provincial centre halfway by road from Xauxa to Cuzco.

limitations: Translations: Xerez via Markham 1872 (1970 reprint); Sancho 1917. These are translated editions, not manuscripts.
Exact dates unverified; Motux stages 4 and 5 duplicate the entry.

draft.title: Later book portrayal
draft.summary: Guaman Poma portrays Atahualpa requesting speech from a silent book.

claims.text: Guaman Poma portrays Atahualpa requesting the book and protesting its silence.
Interpretation of this portrayal: the book’s silence marks tension in the exchange.
Metadata: Indigenous Peruvian author, later early-seventeenth-century chronicle.

limitations: Portrayed dialogue; neither verified 1532 speech nor a universal Andean view.
Inconsistent narrative chronology; incomplete hosted transcription.
